step1_analysis.description: A common-source (or common-emitter) RF amplifier with an inductive load for high-frequency operation, typically used in WLAN receivers. It features a complex active bias network to stabilize the operating point of the main amplifying transistor.

paper_reference.title: A Fully Integrated Multiband MIMO WLAN Transceiver RFIC

Voltage_Gain.description: AC voltage gain (S21 equivalent) at the operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is determined by gm * Z_load. At resonance, Z_load is limited by inductor Q and output resistance. Assuming gm ~ 20mA/V and R_p ~ 500 ohms, gain is ~10 V/V or 20 dB. Loaded with 50 ohms, it will be lower.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 NMOS driving a 50-ohm load; the paper's 15 dB is a reasonable target for a single-stage LNA.

Center_Frequency.description: Frequency at which the voltage gain peaks.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=2nH and C_tune=0.4pF + parasitics, f ~ 5.2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The LC tank is tuned to match the paper's reported 5.2 GHz WLAN band.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the amplifier and its bias circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Assuming 10mA for the main branch and 2mA for bias at 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single LNA stage typically consumes 5-15 mA. Scaled for 1.8V SKY130 supply.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, center frequency, and transient output swing of the LNA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=50u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_bias=5u L_bias=0.15u

* DUT (npn converted to sky130 NMOS for compatibility)
XM3 N5 N3 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_bias} L={L_bias}
R1 N1 N4 10k
XM4 N3 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_bias} L={L_bias}
XM1 N2 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_xm1} L={L_xm1}
R3 VDD N5 1k
C2 N1 GND 10p
C1 N4 IN 1p
R5 VDD N3 1k
R2 N0 N1 10k
C4_OUT N2 OUT 1p
XM2 VDD N5 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_bias} L={L_bias}
C4 N3 GND 10p
C3 N5 GND 10p
R4 N6 GND 200
L1 VDD N2 2n

* Tuning capacitor to set resonance near 5.2 GHz
C_tune N2 GND 0.4p

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN IN 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.01 5.2G 0 0)

* Load
RL OUT 0 50

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 50 1G 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac f_peak max_at gain_db
meas ac gain_5g2 find gain_db at=5.2G

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 5n
meas tran vpp_out pp v(OUT)

quit
.endc
